<h2>Compute One Fold of Predictive Decomposition Shares</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Converts full and reduced model values into the established loss or
higher-is-better metric share schema.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>compute_predictive_fold_shares(
  data_fold,
  value_column,
  direction = base::c("lower", "higher"),
  metric_name = value_column
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_fold">data_fold</code></td>
<td>
<p>One repeat-fold data frame containing full and reduced variants.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="value_column">value_column</code></td>
<td>
<p>Name of the loss or performance column.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="direction">direction</code></td>
<td>
<p>Either '&quot;lower&quot;' for loss or '&quot;higher&quot;' for performance.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="metric_name">metric_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Output metric label used when 'direction = &quot;higher&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A three-row tibble containing component shares for one fold.
</p>

</main>
